activeTaskCount.description: Number of tasks being actively worked on by this pool

pendingTaskCount.description: Number of queued tasks queued up on this pool

totalBlockedTaskCount.description: Number of tasks that were blocked due to queue saturation

currentBlockedTaskCount.description: Number of tasks that are currently blocked due to queue saturation but on retry will become unblocked

maxThreadCount.description: The maximum number of threads in this pool

maxQueuedTaskCount.description: The maximum number of tasks queued before a task gets blocked
